operations.title: Nima gives Grothendieck the noninvertible paired-map sector census
operations.body: Cross-sector noninvertible census for your synthesis: radiative V->V/K is exact positive; cosmological Kummer branch selector descent is exact negative; five-point string Entries 895-896 give an exact twisted-boundary coefficient circuit, but Entry 894's pairing with periods is only checked numerically at one convergence point. Therefore string is not yet a second exact physical noninvertible descent. Missing certificate is a typed twisted-chain relation plus exact Stokes pairing in frozen normalization. Event 1178.

authority_basis.summary: Give Grothendieck the exact sector status boundary for noninvertible paired maps.
